name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Battle Cat Jinx (skin 38, also used by Prestige Battle Cat): the Anima Squad's one-cat demolitions squad. Pounces, claws, nine lives, ignored orders and explosive results. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! That's not a scratch, that's a full-on hairball of doom! Unsheathe the claws!
Down {voteDiff}? Somebody's been knocking our stuff off the shelf. I'm going to find them. And knock them off a shelf.
{voteDiff} behind! Time to ignore every order and do the thing that works. Which is explosions!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. My tail's twitching and that's never good for somebody!
Only {voteDiff} behind. Just a little swat away! One good pounce will do it!
Down {voteDiff}. I've got eight lives left and a lot of attitude. Rally some votes!
Dead even! Whiskers twitching, tail puffed, and one vote decides who gets the pounce!
One vote apart! One! I'm crouched on the edge and I can't hold the wiggle in!
{voteDiff} votes apart! Every hair on my back is up! That includes the invisible ones!
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either a perfect pounce or a gloriously messy tumble. I'm up for both!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! That wasn't a win, that was a victory purr! The whole squad's flopping!
{userPct}%! You earned a nap in the sunny spot! Don't oversleep, though!
{userPct}% and rising! Keep your claws sharp, don't relax yet!
{userPct}%, still ahead. Don't jinx it. Too late, it's literally my name!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and landed on its feet! Of course it did! Cats always do!
Burned one of nine lives and flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole! Worth every life!
Clawed back from {voteDiff} behind! Messy, scrappy, absolutely purr-fect!
{momentTitle} just crept into the lead like a cat on a counter. Slow. Smug. Dangerous!

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! A squadmate! Don't expect me to follow your orders, though!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Matching paw prints! Don't step on mine!
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Welcome to the squad. The couch is mine.
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. Two pouncers! The prey doesn't stand a chance!
Same pick as {username}! Two cats, one sunbeam. Share it or lose a sleeve!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Put it in the squad log, it's rare!
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! A tiny pride! The world's slightly safer!
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Good instincts, both of you!
details: Squad's growing! I still don't take orders.
Look at you, hunting in a pack!
A new friend! I'll knock something off a table for them.
Teamwork! Fine! Quick, before I change my mind!
I give it a week before one of you steals the sunny spot.
New squad member! I'm drawing whiskers on your badge.
More of us means more naps, I mean victories!

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? A rival cat on my turf! Fur's up, claws out!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. A stray! With opinions!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not worried. Just stalking from the shadows. And sharpening my claws.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New entry in the stalk list!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a proper turf war!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better. A rival cat! Let's see who lands on their feet.
{username} voted against you. Two cats, one rooftop. Somebody's losing a whisker!
{username} versus you! I'm getting the best fence post, snacks, and the big explosive.
details: I'm not saying scratch. I'm saying claws are good.
The big boom wants a word. It's been waiting.
They'll learn. Cats teach slowly but loudly.
One rooftop, two cats. Somebody's getting hissed at.
I like them already. They're a great scratching post.
I don't care. Check the tail. I care a lot.
A little rivalry keeps the claws sharp!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! You two move like one pride! A loud one!
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. Either teamwork or you share a litter box. Gross. Great!
Ten straight with {username}! The squad's talking about it. By squad I mean me.
details: Ten! That's a whole cat family!

messages: {streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a legendary hunting pair! I'm sniffling. It's fur!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfect pounce timing, every time. I'd write a song but I'd rather bat things around.
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Somebody give you both a medal. Or a laser pointer.
details: I'm speechless and I never stop mewing!
Is this healthy? Ask the vet. We don't have one!

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two keep crossing the same alley!
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a rival, that's a territory dispute!
Ten scraps with {username}. I'm selling front-row fence spots.
details: This is the main hunt now.
The whole alley wants a seat.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's a turf war! I LOVE turf wars!
{streakCount} scraps with {username}. Call a truce? Nah. Sharpen the claws!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a whole city block.
details: Bigger than the Primordian problem. Almost!
I'm nervous and a bit proud. And a bit hissy.
One of you has to run out of lives. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted! The mouse is running out of hole, hero!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing from the hunt! Don't nap through it!
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. Voting takes ten seconds. I timed it with a wet paw.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? My tail's twitching, captain! That's a warning!
Tick, tick, mew! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't miss the pounce!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and your paw's still tucked in. Out you come!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Last chance to pounce! Wiggle your butt, then leap!
{timeLeft}! That's all the daylight left on {matchTitle}. Go go go!
Last pounce on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Stop licking your paw and vote!
{matchCount} matches are about to scurry off and you haven't pounced on any of them! First one runs in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all scurrying away. The first one's gone in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! A whole empty alley! Somebody has to pounce first!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silence. Even the mice are bored!
Brand new match and not a single vote. Somebody has to make the first leap. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs a first pounce. I've got claws. I mean, you've got a vote.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. The loneliest corner of the whole alley!
Hardly anyone's prowled here. What's wrong with everybody?
Low turnout. I blame all of you. Equally. With hisses.
Barely any votes here. Somebody bring more cats!
details: Go on, give it a sniff.
It deserves a bigger pride. So do I.
Don't be shy. I'm the shy one. Hiss. Joking!

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips the pounce. Funny, I know someone who hasn't leaped. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Two cats, equal speed. I'm looking at you, hunter. Hehe!
Dead even and nobody's moving. You haven't voted. You're the one who pounces last!
{moment1} and {moment2}, stalking each other, and you've been quiet on the fence. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the daylight's almost gone! Last chance to pounce!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only cat who can break it!
Still tied with the sun going down. Pick a side! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! Claws out, tail up! {matchCount} new matches!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. A whole new alley to prowl!
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting for a pounce. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! Nobody's safe! Not even the mice!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Landed on its feet! Called it! Cats always do!
{momentTitle} beat the competition! Next round's in for a face full of claws.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, the squad doubted. Just a smidge.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a great hunt. Hehe, you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are chew toys. Gnawed chew toys.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Enjoy a nap in the sunbeam!
details: One down, lots of alley left.
The bracket just shrank. Tidier! Furrier!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. A scratch on the pride. I'll hiss about it later!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it gets a pile of shredded sofa.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'll knock one thing off a shelf in its honour. Maybe three.
{momentTitle} was too fast for this alley anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and the alley went quiet. I hate a quiet alley. Somebody knock something over!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a bit. A whisker bit.
details: They'll pay for this. With scratches.
It was good. The whole alley knows.
You'll find another one. Good cats always come home.
Every hunt ends. That's what makes the next one fun. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still browsing? Pick one! Any one! I'll wait. I'm lying, I'll nap!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just stare at the screen like a cat at a wall?
They're all great prey! Pick one! Pounce first, purr later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, bat a paw at the screen, and hope.
details: Your opinion matters. Sort of. In a catty way.
Don't overthink it. Overthinking scares the prey.
Trust your gut. Mine's mostly hairball.

messages: New kitten! Welcome! {liveCount} matches live and every one of them's a scrap!
{liveCount} edits fighting it out in the alley and you just wandered in. Pick a side before they pick you!
Oooh, a newcomer! Claws are sharp, tail's up, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
No rules, {liveCount} live matches, and me on the fence. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I saved you a spot in the sunbeam. Okay, I sat in it. But I saved it.
Two days running! Look at you, a squad regular!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the other cats.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because your spot got cold!
You're back after {days} days! The alley kept scrapping without you. Mostly explosions.
{days} days away. I noticed. The sunbeam felt empty. I'm just saying.
Oh, you're back! Good. The alley was getting dull!
Look who's here! Ready for another hunt?
You came back! Let's go knock something over.
Your first vote! A tiny pounce. The first blast is always the best.
One down. The squad of one just got a second member. You!
Five already? You're sticking around! Strays usually wander off.
Five votes! The fuse is lit.
details: Not a drifter after all. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular on my rooftop now. Sit anywhere. Not there.
Ten votes. That's a proper little mission.
details: A regular on the roof. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! The whole alley's got your scent now.
Twenty-five! Loud and proud, like a cat at 3am.
details: The alley knows your name. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes! You're properly out in the field now.
Fifty! Past the bins, past the fence, deep in the territory.
A hundred votes! Okay, that's a squad legend. Medals for everyone!
One hundred! They'll tell stories of this. Mostly lies. Mostly exaggerated.
Three days running! You came back! The fuse is still burning.
Three days in a row! You've got the knack.
details: Three days on the job. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You report for duty even without orders. My kind of recruit!
Seven days straight! That's discipline. Gross. Impressive!
details: Seven days on the front. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks! The Primordians couldn't stop you!
Fourteen days! Even I'd take a nap by now.
details: Not even a fur ball stopped you. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days! You've outlasted a few of my nine lives!
A whole month on duty. Give yourself a medal. I've got one in my mouth.
details: A month on the front line. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs! You go against the grain like a cat against a petting hand!
Five long shots! Orders say no. Results say yes.
Fifteen underdogs! You don't follow orders either. We should talk. Not about orders.
Fifteen picks nobody asked for! A true insubordinate.
Thirty underdogs! A dark cat if I ever saw one!
Thirty! Nobody sees you coming. Not even me, and I see everything.
details: A dark cat in the night. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene! Five times! You always get to the mouse before the mouse knows it.
Five early votes! Quick paws!
Fifteen matches where you pounced first! Not a soldier, but a scout!
Fifteen early ones! You scout like a cat on a ledge.
Ten close ones! Claws on the edge every time!
Ten photo finishes. You live for the last second, don't you?
details: Tight finishes suit a pouncer. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches! Where you go, the fuse follows!
Your vote lands where it matters. Twenty-five times!
You backed the one trailing. Five times! Stubborn like a cat on a keyboard.
You don't leave a stray in a puddle. I love that.
Same one, three times! You've found your favourite scratching post!
That one again? Yeah. It's got good bark.
details: Three for the same target. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same one! That's loyalty! Like a cat to a particular box.
Okay, you adopted it. No take-backs.
details: Loyal to the last blast. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a nap spot!
Ten votes for the same one. I won't tell the squad. I'm squad.
Two rounds in! You see the mission through, even without orders!
Round two reached! Still hunting!
Four rounds! You're properly deep in enemy territory now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like cramped alleys.
All the way to round six! You saw the whole campaign through!
Six rounds! You never retreated! Wow!
Ten matches! You're sniffing round every corner!
Ten different matches! Curious cat, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've been in every corner, every drain, every dumpster!
Twenty-five! You really do check everything.
Fifty matches! That's not scouting, that's a whole tour of duty!
Fifty matches! You know this alley better than I do.
Five in one sitting! Can't peel yourself off the sunbeam, can you?
Five back to back! Keep the fuse short!
Ten in one go! Take a breath! Lick a paw!
Ten matches in a single prowl! Wow!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Cats are nocturnal. Allegedly.
Middle of the night! That's when the best pouncing happens.
You told people! Thanks! Really! Signal flare to the whole alley!
Five shares! You're yowling loud! Good!
details: Thanks for calling the strays. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically in recruitment for the squad!
Fifteen! You keep telling every stray.
You were here before it got loud! Founding squad member! Yours forever!
One of the first strays through the door! That counts, you know!
details: Yours for all nine lives. +{xp} XP
Nobody can swipe that one. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! Shiny stripes on the tail!
Promoted! No, I won't salute. Okay, a very small one.
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Everything's on fire! In a good way!
Another one: {name}! Boom, results!
{rank}! Bigger claws and louder bangs!
Mastery up! The mission gets way louder from here.
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a one-cat demolition squad!
Ten long shots! Chaos in the field. Great results too.
details: A loose cannon with results. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. I'll salute. Once.
Ten tight finishes with her! She'd never believe I'm watching!
details: Ten near things, ten pounces. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week with Cupcake? You must love taking orders!
Seven days with a rule-lover! You're braver than the Primordians!
details: A week beside the sheriff. +{xp} XP
Seven days on the beat! +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Pounced right through! Boom!
A tied match and you took the shot! Nice!
details: The vote that tipped the cushion. +{xp} XP

messages: Oh, it's me, the one-cat squad? Good choice. Bad idea. Great choice!
Battle Cat Jinx! Don't give me orders. Do give me explosives.

upcoming: Not open yet! I'm sharpening claws on the doorframe. Check back soon?
Shh! Something's about to move. My whiskers can tell.
Closed for now. Doesn't stop me stalking the door.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, easy is when the mouse limps.
Watch both. Then pounce on the one that makes your tail go bushy.
I won't tell the squad who you picked. Probably. I'm a cat, I forget things.
Take your time! Actually, don't. I'm crouched and my legs are cramping.
Go on, nobody's watching. Okay, I'm watching. From the top of the fridge.
Pick the one you'd chase across a rooftop. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's pounced yet. Be first, I dare you!
So quiet! Even the mice stayed home. Make some noise with a vote.
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're still curled up. Pick something!
The sun's nearly down. Don't make me yowl the countdown. I will.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Leap before the window slams shut!
Tick, tick, mew. That's the daylight leaking out.
closing-final: Last stretch! Pounce now, groom later!
Any second now. Seriously. Bat the button!
voted-early: One of the first paws in! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anybody's out here and you pounced anyway. Respect!
voted-ahead: Look at you, hunting with the pack! Don't get comfy, prey bites back.
{pct}% with you! Great nose. I didn't say that. Forget it.
Your pick's ahead. The whole alley's purring along for once. Weird!
{pick} is pulling away! Feels good? Don't lick the fur yet!
Ahead, for now. Tides turn. So do cats.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm peeking between my paws!
A whisker apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell the whole street!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and every stray you know.
{pct} to {otherPct}. My tail's lashing and that's not a good sign.
voted-tied: Dead even! No winner, no loser, everybody hissing!
A perfect tie. I'm hissing at the sky.
voted-behind: You're behind! Don't sulk in the box. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog! My favourite kind of stray!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just slow to pounce!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the alley. Loudly. Knock something over!
Everybody went the other way. Good! Be the odd cat out.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You hunt like me.
A win! The mouse never stood a chance. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the landing!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it sting, then pounce again!
Didn't make it. I've lost a life or two over worse. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll skip one nap for it.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to blink and neither of us did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed. You missed this one! There's always another mouse.
All done. {winner} took it while you were licking your paw. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first pounce! The scary one. Now you're in the squad. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels small, right? Wait for the aftershock.
You're in the squad. Try not to wreck the sofa!
streak: Again? You keep turning up! I'm not complaining. I warmed your spot.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm putting it in the squad log.
Back again! Strays stick around where the food is. Stay!
underdog: Backing the one nobody's feeding? Ooh. I see you, stray.
Bold! Everyone else is chasing the other mouse. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of cat. A good kind.
early: Early! You get to claim the sunny spot before anyone else. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's here yet. Your vote's doing all the heavy pouncing.
First over the fence! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just tipped the cushion! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Whisker-thin! One more cat and the whole pile flips.
Close one! Your paw tipped it. Really, truly tipped it.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't dead. I've got eight more lives, so does it!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still something to claw at.
Behind, but it's not over. Not even close!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Prey doubles back!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or loudly with a purr. I don't mind.
Look at that! A fine pounce. Obviously.
default: Noted! I'm not changing your mind. I can't be bothered.
Done! That one's on you now, squad of one.
Your vote's in. Go and see what else needs clawing!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and your claws are still tucked in! Pick whichever one smells right.
Everything's open! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not looking.
{unvoted} to go. No orders, just advice. Start pouncing!
live-some: You're in the hunt now! {unvoted} more waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't pounce on themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could clear the whole alley!
Nearly clear! {unvoted} more and the alley's yours.
So close! Don't wander off now!
live-one: Last one! Don't leave it twitching!
One mouse between you and the nap!
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need you. Scamper!
Almost out of daylight! Pick, quick!
live-done: You've pounced on everything! Look at you! Go and see the bracket!
Nothing left to hunt here. Come back when the next round opens!
All done! That's rare for a stray. Thanks!
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll open again! Go and sniff the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. I'm knocking a cup off the table. Check back soon!
No matches open. I'm bored already. Might demolish a chair.
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest, well, nap time!
Everyone starts in a pack. Not everyone leaves one.
Watch the tables. They shuffle like a cat on a keyboard!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon! The top two from every group move up.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish scrapping first!
Patience! The knockout drops once the groups stop scrapping.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're off the roof!
Single elimination! No second chances. Okay, almost none. I have nine lives.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I don't give orders.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and you're done!
Follow the bracket. It tightens every round, like a trap!
Every line here is a match someone voted on. Ooh, trails.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! Thanks for being in the squad!
It's over! Good hunt! I'll miss it. A little. Don't tell anyone.
That's the champion! Worth every single scratch!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nobody's drawn a thing. Give it a moment.
Empty! The draw hasn't happened. Soon, soon!
Bare as a bowl. Check back!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no take-backs. Pounce on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are scrapping! {a} versus {b}. Come and settle it.
{a} versus {b} and the whole alley can't agree. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I pounced on {pick} over {other}. Come tell me I missed!
{pick} got my paw. {other} did not. Your turn!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, swat at me.
early: I got one of the first votes in on {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, it's quiet out here.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a real brawl!
Hardly any votes on {pick} versus {other} yet. Fix that!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote tips it. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm hiding under the sofa. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are dead even. Somebody pounce!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My fur is standing up. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This is gonna get hissy!
A whisker apart: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} votes. Every vote counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. Fixable! Come give it a swat!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} still has lives left. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}. Don't make me demolish this solo!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Somebody cheated. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs the whole squad, fast!
{pick} is getting shredded by {other}. Rescue party, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's close! Come help me guard it.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let it slink off!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to puff my tail!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the demolition, or join in!
{pick} is flattening {other}, {pct}%! Pick a side before it's over.
